command_inventory.signature: Gameplay.execute(module_id: String, operation: String, args: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary
command_inventory.args: Forwarded to simulation.command; requires phase=free_roam and no restore_error.
command_inventory.result: Rules dictionary; successful call syncs global time, location, checkpoints and changed signal.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Future event input must use the existing main entry after a runtime operation is approved.

command_inventory.signature: command(module_id: String, operation: String, args: Dictionary = {}) -> Dictionary
command_inventory.args: Existing registered module and operation; validates arguments and before/after hooks.
command_inventory.result: {ok:true,data:Dictionary} or {ok:false,error:String}; restores state and rng.state on failure.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: One transaction boundary; do not nest command calls or dispatch synchronously from domain_event.

command_inventory.args: id is existing NPC in player contacts; text nonempty. incoming defaults false; do not spoof incoming=true.
command_inventory.result: Rules.ok() with empty data; appends id/npc/text/incoming/read/minute and increments next_message_id.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Can send a player message, but has no source_message_id, in_reply_to, instance_id or returned message_id. HumanSocial additionally checks contact boundary.

command_inventory.result: Marks ALL messages whose npc==id read, returns empty Rules.ok().
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Not a message-specific acknowledgement; do not silently mark unrelated messages read.

command_inventory.args: Optional initiative token only for an existing initiative; no arbitrary event node/source message selector.
command_inventory.result: Rules.ok(presentation) with node/channel/turn/utterance/choices, or failure; availability checks contact/sleep/busy.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Opens authored root/initiative; cannot claim it clarifies the selected source message.

command_inventory.args: Choice must exist in current presentation, turn must match; alternate choose_menu uses its own menu.
command_inventory.result: Rules.ok(reply); topic choices in message channel append player_reply and npc_reply immediately.
command_inventory.minutes_now: Owner choice minutes; e.g. day/feelings/goal=3, leave=0; not the proposed4-minute clarification.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Wrong binding for asynchronous tone clarification; cannot invent clarify choice.

command_inventory.args: Use actual directed NPC IDs; require saved npc.mind.bonds.has(other) before using historical fields.
command_inventory.result: Copy with scales, last_contact and stage; missing bond synthesizes _new_bond with last_contact=now.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Existing friendship projection; not evidence of cancelled NPC meetings or a newly generated bond.

command_inventory.args: other defaults player. If other != player, fails use_npc_autonomy.
command_inventory.result: For valid player interaction returns Rules.ok({accepted,chance,reason}) after owner time; NPC pair call is rejected.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Explicitly forbidden as NPC→NPC event binding.

command_inventory.signature: calendar.conflict(id: String, destination: String, minutes: int, priority: int = 50, ignore_appointment: int = -1, ignore_schedule: int = -1, forecast: Dictionary = {}) -> String
command_inventory.args: Total occupied time includes actual route and owner action; do not pass priority>=100 for optional events.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Check both NPCs independently and retain onward travel to next obligation.

command_inventory.signature: submit_pair(a: String, b: String, action: String = "") -> bool
command_inventory.args: Known distinct NPCs; empty action means reproductive encounter, not ordinary visit.
command_inventory.result: true means request enqueued, not consent, execution, completion or reward; execute only supports inspect.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Do not call with empty action. Not a complete calendar/consent guard; future owner must validate matching case and both schedules.

command_inventory.args: Called on actual active action completion; partner availability, reciprocal active binding and personality guards required.
command_inventory.result: Delegates resolve(actor,target,action), sets last_social, records social_outcome and returns accepted.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: This is the running NPC path inherited by CityAgency, not the older base NPC formula.

command_inventory.signature: resolve(actor: String, target: String, action: String) -> Dictionary
command_inventory.args: Actual existing social action; called by owner after scheduling, not by event preview.
command_inventory.result: {accepted,chance,reason}; uses RNG, directed gains/limits and emits pending npc_social_outcome(actor,target,action,accepted). Does not advance time.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Do not invoke directly to skip owner duration, consent/availability or action completion; emitted payload lacks case/action instance ID.

command_inventory.args: NPC+player meeting; future minute, real location, player appointment conflict checks.
command_inventory.result: Appends {npc,minute,location,status:pending}; no a/b fields, proposal acceptance record or NPC-pair cancellation archive.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Not a scheduler or factual trigger source for an NPC-only meeting.

command_inventory.args: Schema/catalog hash/state/RNG validated; main runtime adds its own schema and city-home-owner contract.
command_inventory.result: Base exports schema/catalog_hash/rng_seed/rng_state/state. Restore rehydrates existing state or rejects.
command_inventory.use_in_slice: Current active actions and messages have persistence; proposed random-event instances do not exist in the current state contract.

missing_bindings.needed: A bounded saved event instance keyed by event_id+owner_incident_id+ordered roles, selected choice, due, result identity and consumed marker, committed inside existing transaction. No new public signature is asserted.
Author-owned ambiguity/non-refusal semantic tag and source_message_id. Existing kind=npc_reply or message length does not prove tone; do not infer anger from random text.
Owner-confirmed outgoing message_id, in_reply_to/source correlation and single-message read semantics; exactly one source-bound reply, no arbitrary incoming injection.
Apply4/2/0 minutes once inside owner-approved instance transaction, revalidate contact after elapsed time, append no automatic NPC answer. Do not compose two external commands with partial success.
Stable real cancelled/missed commitments between A and B with their roles, accepted plan identity, time, reason and knowledge provenance. last_contact and player appointments are insufficient.
Owner-approved choice a/b/leave attached to the actual A→B case with independent response by B; do not force _start or call player interact.
Correlate actual start/completion/cancel to event instance, pair, action, started/due and unique owner outcome; ordinary clock.advance success cannot identify this event.
A genuine private A→B acknowledgement of distance with8-minute proposed local duration; current player dialogue is not NPC→NPC speech. Do not use romantic separate or apply false friend breakup.
Activate existing re_phone_tone_reply only on actual correlated incoming reply; keep same participants and parent result. No new card is added.

required_context.source: existing state.social.messages record with stable id,npc,incoming=true,read=false,minute
required_context.knowledge: player is the actual recipient; private to participants

a.result_rule: Outgoing message is real success of sending, not proof of tone, reply or relationship gain.

b.result_rule: No message, appointment or obligation created; same source not reoffered for1440 minutes.

leave.result_rule: Dismiss only this offer; do not close the unrelated npc_dialogue session or mark all messages read.

steps: Read-only eligibility binds source57 and NPC42; preview does not consume RNG/time or mark messages read.

Future approved choice a validates exact source and contact, consumes4 minutes within one transaction, then owner appends outgoing58 once. Current social.message alone would use0 minutes and return empty data.
Record one parent result tied to outgoing58; balance120/80 and inventories unchanged. No incoming59 is invented. Event waits for real reply.
If a genuine correlated incoming59 arrives later, validate same NPC and source/parent then make existing re_phone_tone_reply available once.
Reopening, repeated click or restoring a post-send snapshot cannot append another58 or replay4 minutes.
alternatives: b uses2 local minutes once; sends nothing; no automatic future contact.
leave uses0 minutes; closes only this source offer; no new relation penalty.
walkthrough.failure: Source pruned, boundary revoked, busy owner or invalid commit restores all state/RNG/time; no consumed result or message appears.

required_context.actor: existing adult NPC A, never player
required_context.target: existing adult NPC B, never player
required_context.source: two actual accepted pair commitments later cancelled/missed, stable IDs; proposed2 in7days is slice fixture, not current runtime rule
required_context.relationship: saved directed bonds in both NPCs, adult mutual acquaintance/friend context; view() alone may synthesize defaults
required_context.knowledge: only A/B actual accepted commitments; player not an observer or recipient
required_context.place: example city_park, only if both already there with actual access; do not add routes or force travel

a.existing_primitive: human_social_outcome only after real autonomous connect action; no public NPC invitation command
a.duration_rule: 6-minute proposal and later30-minute connect are distinct phases only if both really occur; do not count6 as completed meeting or append30 twice. Owner review required.
a.result_rule: Pair response/plan acceptance gives no completed-meeting reward. Only real owner completion can record success.

b.result_rule: Do not delete bond, call separate, zero grievance or invent an answered NPC message.

leave.result_rule: Existing schedules, care, obligations and neglect rules remain; no player notification.

steps: Current build must stop: no authoritative NPC-pair cancellation source and no event instance exist. Do not substitute player appointments or last_contact.

After future approved bindings, A independently chooses a. B independently agrees or refuses. During6-minute proposal check both calendars including subsequent30-minute connect and10-minute onward route:6+30+10=46 <=60.
Accepted proposal binds one plan/result, not a completed meeting. No salary, XP or relation gain for invitation. A/B/player money remain90/70/120 for this local case.

Only if ordinary autonomy actually starts matched connect for the pair: both active records refer to each other; due uses owner catalog30 minutes, and existing CityAgency→HumanAgency path controls interruption/completion.

At actual completion HumanAgency._social_outcome calls resolve once, which may accept or decline. Record only matching committed owner outcome. Clock advance by a player elsewhere is not itself proof of this meeting.
No player notification or knowledge is added. Restore mid-action must preserve existing due and event correlation; after completed snapshot no second outcome or relation gain.
alternatives: B refusal is an independent social outcome; event does not retry until consent appears.
b would spend8 minutes only through a reviewed NPC-private utterance owner; this binding currently does not exist.
leave costs0, sends nothing, erases no past cancellation or ordinary neglect.
walkthrough.failure: An urgent task, changed access, unavailable B or calendar conflict ends/blocks the optional plan; no forced _start, player transfer or instant resolve.
